components.name: Theme Control
components.description: Persistent Dark/Light choice in the sidebar reading controls.
components.css: .ds-theme-control { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; color: #e9eae5; font: .8125rem "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-theme-control legend { margin-bottom: 6px; color: #929a9a; font-size: .75rem; } .ds-theme-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #2a2e30; border-radius: 7px; background: #101214; } .ds-theme-options button { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: #929a9a; background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-options button:hover { color: #e9eae5; background: #1d2123; } .ds-theme-options button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #c7ee79; background: #c7ee7910; } .ds-theme-options button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c7ee79; outline-offset: 0; }

narrative.overview: A compact, pane-based recorder UI that preserves its charcoal-and-lime dark baseline while offering a muted off-white, mostly grayscale light alternate. Theme changes recolor existing surfaces and retain typography, layout, icon strokes, and responsive behavior.

rules.name: The Preserved Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the baseline visual system; alternate-theme work must not alter its tokens or appearance.

rules.name: The Restrained Light Rule
rules.body: In light mode, ordinary navigation and controls stay grayscale; green and red communicate semantic status rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Stable Frame Rule
rules.body: Theme changes recolor existing surfaces; they do not move navigation, library, replay, or top-bar structure.

dos: Do preserve the dark token set when extending light mode.
Do use the grayscale light stack for standard light surfaces and selection.
Do keep Theme with sidebar reading controls, including the mobile drawer.
donts: Don't infer theme from system appearance.
Don't use lime as general light-mode decoration.
Don't change typography, spacing, or responsive structure for a palette switch.
